objective: Make the remote starry ocean sky feel cinematic while optimizing the complete native rendering workload.
previousTurnClassification: Progress: current native state inspected; earlier snapshots/tests revalidated rather than treated as completion.
visualChanges: Replaced cloud-noise galaxy with a locally bundled NASA/Gaia-derived linear HDR sky background.
Reduced resolved foreground catalogue from 28,000 to 12,000 with a much wider brightness distribution and restrained color variation.
Preserved analytic sharp point stars, cloud transmission, sidereal rotation, lunar phase/lighting and fixed camera.
Source radiance gives the ocean matching warm/cool reflected illumination.

asset.credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio; Gaia DR2: ESA/Gaia/DPAC. Visualization: Ernie Wright.
asset.description: Milky Way background excluding bright Hipparcos/Tycho stars.
asset.projection: plate carree, ICRF/J2000; RA 0 at image centre, increasing left; north at top
asset.runtimeDependencies: None. Native Metal uploads packed linear data directly; ffmpeg/NumPy only needed to regenerate.

validation.scope: Synthetic public coordinates only. No network requests, OS location access, windows or user cache writes. All sky/environment/sun readbacks checked; visual fixtures need review.

headlessLifecycle.scope: No NSWindow or drawable acquisition, application activation policy prohibited; original windowed captures used only as saved fixtures. The 12-sample benchmark is a lifecycle smoke test, not a performance comparison.

performance.scope: Unprofiled command-buffer times, 180 frames/run with 60-frame warmup; matched scene/time/resolution/cadence, deliberately different sky appearance. No WindowServer, battery or energy measurement.

memory.tradeoff: A modest immutable data increase replaces recurring synthesis and improves appearance while reducing measured night GPU time.

completionAudit.cinematicStructure: Reviewed matched before/after hero render, moonlit scene and fixed west-facing night: detailed dust/stellar structure replaces soft procedural stripe; prominent stars no longer form a uniform dot field.
completionAudit.performance: Eight alternating night runs plus four daytime runs, same cadence/resolution/time, warmup excluded; whole-command-buffer night mean improves and daytime is essentially unchanged.
completionAudit.boundedWork: Existing sky cache/cube cadence, single render loop, internal pixel budget and hidden/sleep pause gates retained; galaxy data uploaded once, no runtime image synthesis or downloads.
completionAudit.fidelity: 13 GPU scene checks, actual packed-HDR decode and mip-energy checks, 1K/2K reflection render comparison, windowless lifecycle/startup-failure paths and unchanged tested astronomy/IP/lifecycle core.

limitations: Image taste is an artistic judgement; previews are actual native output, not a reference photograph.
Resolved foreground stars remain procedural rather than a real constellation catalogue.
Performance is measured locally on Apple M1; no battery, whole-system energy or WindowServer claim.
Source brightness is artistically exposed for the requested remote cinematic scene.

livePreviewVerification.mode: Real local time; reviewed night fixtures separately because local time is daytime.
